paper.title: Robo-Cortex: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent via Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory and Autonomous Knowledge Induction
paper.central_claim: 通过 Imagine-then-Verify、双粒度认知记忆和 AKI，将具身执行轨迹抽象成跨 episode 留存的导航启发式；这些启发式可迁移至未见环境，持续在线更新进一步改善导航成功率与效率。

provenance.notes: 本席按现有 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol 配置执行；没有可独立核验的后端模型回执、会话 ID 或 receipt，故三项为 null，不额外探测。a3 依用户指令显式 supersedes a1，未读取 a1、其他席、aggregate、conflicts、archive 或 screen 判定。相同 r20b manifest；attempt 覆盖由本次派发指定，不修改 manifest。外部补充材料不属于钉定 arXiv 文档；只依据正文独立判断它是否承载必要核心证据。

materials.notes: 已完整阅读固定的 HTML 转文本（1496 行），方法、结果及局限均在正文。§4.1 指向 supplementary 的是 additional implementation details；正文没有将核心结果表或关键主张唯一证据移交外部补充。未报告的阈值、prompt、分母、统计和成本属于作者报告缺口，不是 needs_fulltext。manifest 无 page_images；图4数值仅引用正文解说，不推测图内未转录点。

evidence.quote:
experiential amnesia
: the failure to transform past interactions into reusable decision knowledge that generalizes across environments.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者将具体 gap 定位于轨迹/局部记忆难以转化为跨环境决策知识，而非只有冻结权重口号。

evidence.quote: Voyager learns a library of executable skills in a simulator-native domain, EvoAgent continually updates the world model for long-horizon embodied tasks, and C-NAV adapts navigation representations to new object categories under continual learning
evidence.support_explanation: 作者提供技能库、世界模型更新和持续导航三条谱系；这是本文对邻居的描述，未核邻居原文，不能作独立新颖性证明。

evidence.quote: After executing the selected decision, Robo-Cortex updates the state and re-enters the planning loop rather than trusting a long open-loop rollout.
evidence.support_explanation: world-model/VLM 候选选择后真实执行并重规划；这是任务控制闭环，不单独证明跨任务留存收益。

evidence.quote: This reflective cue is then appended to the planner context for subsequent decisions within the same episode
evidence.support_explanation: SRM 滑窗总结只影响当前 episode，不把它单独当 retained。

evidence.quote: A principle analyzer converts this trajectory into a guiding principle for successful episodes or a cautionary principle for failed episodes.
evidence.support_explanation: LPM 将成功/失败的后续轨迹转成指导/警示原则，之后以目标条件嵌入检索；有结果 grounding，但未指定成功信号具体可见权限。

evidence.quote: Successful episodes are prioritized over failed ones, and among successful episodes, shorter trajectories are retained as more efficient behavioral templates. When no successful episode is available, diverse failed episodes are preserved.
evidence.support_explanation: 给出 goal-wise 的成功优先、短轨迹优先及失败多样性保留规则；不是启发式边际效用门控。

evidence.quote: After each episode, the knowledge agent loads the corresponding structured trajectory from the memory graph and applies a vision-language heuristic extractor to identify recurring success and failure patterns.
evidence.support_explanation: AKI 输入为自身 episode 多模态轨迹；产物包含模式 ID、问题、策略、置信度及 success/failure 标签的自然语言启发式。

evidence.quote: Heuristics are first grouped by pattern identifier, and optionally further refined by semantic similarity over their textual descriptions and recommended strategies.
evidence.support_explanation: 模式/语义聚类后 merger 泛化已有内容；有合并而无明示冲突优先级、验证回退或阈值。

evidence.quote: Finally, high-confidence recurrent heuristics are fed back into the online system as structured guidance for short-term reflective analysis and planning.
evidence.support_explanation: 持久库后续确实读取并条件化反思/规划；high-confidence 是模型置信度筛选，不能等同经执行验证的可靠门控。

evidence.quote: Additional implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.
evidence.support_explanation: 外部实现细节指针不独占正文实验结果；正文已给 Habitat、HM3D/MP3D、Qwen2.5-VL-72B、Wan2.1、动作粒度与指标。未提供的实现/成本细节按报告缺口处理，不向外访问。

evidence.quote: Compared with the strongest baseline, Robo-Cortex improves IGNav by +2.69% SR and +4.16% SPL, while also achieving the best AR success rate and the shortest trajectories on both AR and AEQA.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告静态系统 IGNav SR41.26/SPL31.66，World-In-World38.57/27.50；是百分点差。表1不代表全指标都最好，例如 IGNav mean traj49.90比47.10长。

evidence.quote:
We separate the evaluation set into two disjoint halves,
i.e.
, seen and unseen, to comprehensivly evaluate Robo-Cortex.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确 episode 集合划为两半，支持对 held-out episode 的有限迁移判断；未给 scene ID、随机化、开发选择清单或更强污染审计。

evidence.quote: We first analyze the contribution of Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory under repeated evaluation on the same split.
evidence.support_explanation: 同一 split 反复 round：Basic SR36.11、SRM40.18、round3 LPM43.06、LPM+SRM44.29（IGNav）。不能把重复已见任务收益当独立留出。AR round2组合20.16低于Basic20.93，组合也不全指标占优。

evidence.quote: In this setting, no LPM is used, so the comparison focuses on heuristic guidance and online updating.
evidence.support_explanation: 去除原始/具体 LPM 检索后比较同一Basic规划回路上的启发式，是持久启发式作用的重要隔离。
固定 transferred启发式：IGNav SR48.61/SPL39.33，对Basic34.72/24.03和manual38.89/30.96；AR23.02对19.42；AEQA score32.88对32.42，但SPL24.31低于26.80、轨迹19.47长于19.06。结果有明确负向边界。

evidence.quote: it does not surpass the fixed transferred-heuristic setting, suggesting that strong transferred heuristics already provide a high-quality prior and that aggressive online rewriting on limited unseen episodes may partially overwrite useful guidance.
evidence.support_explanation: 在线更新并非总改进：IGNav固定48.61/39.33降至更新41.67/34.84，AR同23.02，AEQA score32.88降32.22；不据此反证一切在线收益，而限制持续演进的普适主张。

evidence.quote: The Basic Pipeline succeeds on 4/10 goals
evidence.support_explanation: 两室内场景有基线分母及失败描述，但增强系统只有代表性SRM恢复案例，没有匹配10目标成功率或不确定性。

evidence.quote: we have not yet systematically evaluated Robo-Cortex with different vision-language backbones or world models.
evidence.support_explanation: 跨模型一般性未证实；真实部署也由作者承认仍是初步小规模。
